glyph_origin: Ideogrammic compound (會意): 雔 (“two birds”) + 又 (“hand”) – Represents two birds (隹) in someone's right hand (又).
s_page_origin: Duplication of 又. Simplified from 䨇 (雔 →), which is also a variant form of 雙*. The earliest known record can be found in Ming dynasty 俗書刊誤. The character 双 bears superficial similarity to the early form of 友. However, the former is not a direct descendant of the latter.
senses: [shuāng] (attributive, of an integer) even (divisible by two)
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 雙; s_page_origin explains the simplified 双.
